svg.desc: POC Baghdad Substations Package LOCATION Iraq CLIENT General Electric (GE) / Iraq Ministry of Electricity COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2023 50 million USD each DISCIPLINES Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This substation package in Iraq was commissioned by General Electric in collaboration with the Iraq Ministry of Electricity. BECT delivered detailed civil and MEP design for multiple POC substations, supporting reliable and safe power infrastructure. Each substation had an estimated construction value of approximately 50 million USD. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management.
